$comment: Vectors for POST /v1/coverage/waiver-certificate (openapi/edge-public.v1.yaml 1.20.0; ops decision D65 item 5; FS-00 §6.3 dated note of 2026-10-28; PS-1913): coverage answered from the company's own waiver certificate. cov-v1 and its vectors are unchanged.

Every certificate is a real compact JWS signed with the committed fixture key psn-dev-2026-1, whose public half every key set below carries (its private half is the website repository's src/data/sample/keys/FIXTURE-DO-NOT-USE.preview-signing.jwk.json, committed on purpose: nothing it signs is a credential). `signed: false` marks the two tokens whose signature must NOT verify under it. The website writes this file (scripts/waiver-certificate-vectors.mjs); scripts/check-certificate-vectors.mjs here checks it: each fixture against its schema, each token's payload against certificate.v1.json, each signature against the key, each expected answer against the WaiverCertificateCoverageResponse component, and that no answer names the company.

A vector publishes `plane` and asks: `repo` names a fixture of `repos` published at registry/repo/{nodeId}.json, or null for none; `waivers` is the document at waivers/{nodeId}.json, or null for none; `ct` maps a segment number to the document at ct/{n}.json, and `latest` to the open segment at ct/latest.json, which the edge reads when its copy of ct/{n}.json does not reach the entry; `keySet` names the key set at jwks.json. `request` is the certificate named, in its compact form or its flattened JSON form (with any `extra` members), padded with spaces after the compact form to `padTo` bytes; or a literal `body`. `now` is the instant of the request. `expect` is the status and, for 200, the body without asOf, which is `now`; for a refusal, the error code.

waiver.why: A waiver certificate as the platform issues one: no end date (OPEN-54 as ruled), signed at its issue.

periodEnded.why: A waiver certificate whose own period ended on 2027-03-31; its waiver is still in force.

issuedLate.why: A waiver certificate dated 2027-05-02, after the retired key set's window for its kid closed.

supporter.why: A supporter certificate, validly signed: not a waiver certificate.

tampered.why: The waiver certificate with its payload rewritten to another company and its signature kept.

algNone.why: The waiver certificate under a header that names the algorithm `none`.

vectors.description: The certificate as issued, presented in its compact form, under the active key: its waiver is in force, so the answer is yes-via-waiver, tied to the certificate by the registry entry's record.certId and the log's issue entry.
vectors.fsRef: ops decision D65 item 5 (coverage from the company's own certificate); FS-00 §6.3 dated note of 2026-10-28

vectors.description: The same certificate in the flattened JSON serialisation (RFC 7515 §7.2.2): the same answer, and the same SHA-256, because the compact form it is rebuilt to is the certificate.
vectors.fsRef: ops decision D65 item 5 (coverage from the company's own certificate); FS-00 §6.3 dated note of 2026-10-28

vectors.description: A masked waiver (D66 item 3): its entry carries no name and no domain, and for now keeps the company id (waiver.v1 1.4.0). The answer is yes-via-waiver and names the certificate, the repository and the waiver, never the company.
vectors.fsRef: ops decision D65 item 5 (coverage from the company's own certificate); FS-00 §6.3 dated note of 2026-10-28; D66 item 3; waiver.v1 beneficiary.display

vectors.description: The masked entry PS-2205 publishes: no company id at all. It is tied to the certificate by record.certId and the log's issue entry alone, and covers. This is the route by which a masked waiver is covered once its entry stops carrying coId.
vectors.fsRef: ops decision D65 item 5 (coverage from the company's own certificate); FS-00 §6.3 dated note of 2026-10-28; the orchestrator's word of 2026-10-21 on L2.3-03 (PS-2205)

vectors.description: The certificate's own period ended on 2027-03-31, and its waiver was never revoked. The route does not read the period: expiry is non-destructive (CERT-041), the certificate still names its waiver, and the registry says the waiver covers now.
vectors.fsRef: ops decision D65 item 5 (coverage from the company's own certificate); FS-00 §6.3 dated note of 2026-10-28; CERT-041

vectors.description: The waiver was revoked on 2027-05-15 (its certificate's revoke entry). Revocation is prospective, and after it the answer is no, with the revocation instant.
vectors.fsRef: ops decision D65 item 5 (coverage from the company's own certificate); FS-00 §6.3 dated note of 2026-10-28; FS-10 §4.3 step 2; CERT-042; D71 item 1

vectors.description: BOUNDARY: one millisecond before revokedAt the waiver is still in force. The answer names the coming revocation, which the public entry carries too.
vectors.fsRef: ops decision D65 item 5 (coverage from the company's own certificate); FS-00 §6.3 dated note of 2026-10-28; FS-10 §4.3 step 2 (cov-v1 vector S1-03)

vectors.description: BOUNDARY (D68 item 8): a waiver covers from the instant it is recorded, its grantedAt.
vectors.fsRef: ops decision D65 item 5 (coverage from the company's own certificate); FS-00 §6.3 dated note of 2026-10-28; D68 item 8 (cov-v1 vector S1-02)

vectors.description: BOUNDARY (D68 item 8): one millisecond before grantedAt the waiver is not in force yet, although its certificate is already signed and logged.
vectors.fsRef: ops decision D65 item 5 (coverage from the company's own certificate); FS-00 §6.3 dated note of 2026-10-28; D68 item 8 (cov-v1 vector S1-01)

basis.note: the waiver is not in force yet

vectors.description: The waiver is in recording[]: its certificate has its issue entry and the registry has not recorded it yet, so it covers nobody (D68 item 8).
vectors.fsRef: ops decision D65 item 5 (coverage from the company's own certificate); FS-00 §6.3 dated note of 2026-10-28; D68 item 8; waiver.v1 recording[]

vectors.description: The waiver was withdrawn before it was recorded (D71 item 2): it stays listed in recording[] as withdrawn, never in force, and the answer is no with the withdrawal instant.
vectors.fsRef: ops decision D65 item 5 (coverage from the company's own certificate); FS-00 §6.3 dated note of 2026-10-28; D71 items 1 and 2

basis.note: the waiver was withdrawn before it was recorded

vectors.description: The repository's waiver document does not carry the waiver the certificate names (here: nothing is published at waivers/{nodeId}.json). The answer is no, as an absent waiver list is an empty one on /v1/coverage.
vectors.fsRef: ops decision D65 item 5 (coverage from the company's own certificate); FS-00 §6.3 dated note of 2026-10-28

basis.note: no waiver with this id is published for this repository

vectors.description: The key is retired, and the certificate was signed inside its validity window: accepted (CERT-022), and the answer is the waiver's.
vectors.fsRef: ops decision D65 item 5 (coverage from the company's own certificate); FS-00 §6.3 dated note of 2026-10-28; FS08-102; CERT-022; src/lib/key-window.mjs key_retired

vectors.description: The certificate says it was signed on 2027-05-02, after its key's window closed on 2027-05-01: the key could not have made it then, a token fault (signed_after_window).
vectors.fsRef: ops decision D65 item 5 (coverage from the company's own certificate); FS-00 §6.3 dated note of 2026-10-28; FS08-102; src/lib/key-window.mjs signed_after_window

vectors.description: The key set marks the certificate's key pending (D90 item 5): nothing signed under it is accepted while the set says so, and the fault is the key set's, not the token's (key_pending).
vectors.fsRef: ops decision D65 item 5 (coverage from the company's own certificate); FS-00 §6.3 dated note of 2026-10-28; D90 item 5; FS-00 §6.4 dated note of 2026-10-26

vectors.description: The key is published compromised with its window ending 2027-03-01, and the certificate says it was signed on 2027-04-01: nothing the key signed from then on is accepted (signed_after_compromise).
vectors.fsRef: ops decision D65 item 5 (coverage from the company's own certificate); FS-00 §6.3 dated note of 2026-10-28; FS08-104; src/lib/key-window.mjs signed_after_compromise

vectors.description: The key is published compromised with its window ending 2027-05-01, after the certificate's 2027-04-01: accepted (Licence 1.0 §9), and the answer says so in basis.certificate.keyWarning. The log's issue entry carries this certificate's hash, which is what shows it was issued then.
vectors.fsRef: ops decision D65 item 5 (coverage from the company's own certificate); FS-00 §6.3 dated note of 2026-10-28; FS08-104; Licence 1.0 §9; src/lib/key-window.mjs key_compromised_before

vectors.description: The key set this deployment publishes has no key with the certificate's kid (kid_unknown): a token fault, and nothing is read from the plane.
vectors.fsRef: ops decision D65 item 5 (coverage from the company's own certificate); FS-00 §6.3 dated note of 2026-10-28; FS08-050

vectors.description: The key set carries two entries under the certificate's kid, so it does not say which key that is (kid_ambiguous): the key set's fault.
vectors.fsRef: ops decision D65 item 5 (coverage from the company's own certificate); FS-00 §6.3 dated note of 2026-10-28; src/lib/key-window.mjs kid_ambiguous

vectors.description: The payload was rewritten to another company and the signature kept: the signature does not verify, which is reported as a forgery before anything else.
vectors.fsRef: ops decision D65 item 5 (coverage from the company's own certificate); FS-00 §6.3 dated note of 2026-10-28; FS08-050

vectors.description: The registry entry names this certificate, but the log's issue entry at its issueSeq carries another hash: the certificate as presented is not the one the log recorded (CERT-030, the rogue-issuance detector).
vectors.fsRef: ops decision D65 item 5 (coverage from the company's own certificate); FS-00 §6.3 dated note of 2026-10-28; CERT-030; waiver.v1 record.issueSeq

vectors.description: The registry entry for the waiver names another certificate in record.certId: the certificate presented is not the waiver's credential, and the answer is no.
vectors.fsRef: ops decision D65 item 5 (coverage from the company's own certificate); FS-00 §6.3 dated note of 2026-10-28; waiver.v1 record.certId

basis.note: the registry names another certificate for this waiver

vectors.description: The registry entry for the waiver names another company id than the certificate's subject: the answer is no, and it names neither company.
vectors.fsRef: ops decision D65 item 5 (coverage from the company's own certificate); FS-00 §6.3 dated note of 2026-10-28; waiver.v1 beneficiary.coId

basis.note: the registry names another organisation for this waiver

vectors.description: An entry published before recording existed carries no record (a development plane's test grants only; waiver.v1 1.3.0): it is tied to the certificate by its company id, the way cov-v1 matches a waiver, and covers.
vectors.fsRef: ops decision D65 item 5 (coverage from the company's own certificate); FS-00 §6.3 dated note of 2026-10-28; waiver.v1 record (absent before recording)

vectors.description: A masked entry with no record and no company id cannot be tied to any certificate, so the answer is no.
vectors.fsRef: ops decision D65 item 5 (coverage from the company's own certificate); FS-00 §6.3 dated note of 2026-10-28

basis.note: the registry entry for this waiver cannot be tied to a certificate

vectors.description: Nothing is published at registry/repo/{nodeId}.json for the repository the certificate names. A waiver is published under a record's node id, so the question cannot be asked: repo_not_registered, as cov-v1 answers it about a waiver (V2-09).
vectors.fsRef: ops decision D65 item 5 (coverage from the company's own certificate); FS-00 §6.3 dated note of 2026-10-28; cov-v1 vector V2-09

vectors.description: The repository's record still says verified, the token published before D82: the answer reports it as registered, as cov-v1 does.
vectors.fsRef: ops decision D65 item 5 (coverage from the company's own certificate); FS-00 §6.3 dated note of 2026-10-28; D82's dated note (d); cov-v1 vector V2-14

vectors.description: An open review (FS-12 §9.8 step 3) annotates the entry and changes nothing: coverage changes only through revokedAt (cov-v1 vector UR-01).
vectors.fsRef: ops decision D65 item 5 (coverage from the company's own certificate); FS-00 §6.3 dated note of 2026-10-28; FS-00 §6.2 dated note of 2026-10-26 (under-review)

vectors.description: The sample plane's key set publishes the fixture key with neither status nor window (key_test_unmanaged): accepted, as on the /verify page, because nothing a test key signs is a credential.
vectors.fsRef: ops decision D65 item 5 (coverage from the company's own certificate); FS-00 §6.3 dated note of 2026-10-28; src/lib/key-window.mjs key_test_unmanaged

vectors.description: BOUNDARY: the compact certificate followed by spaces to exactly 16384 bytes. The body is read, the white space around the compact form is ignored, and the answer is the certificate's.
vectors.fsRef: ops decision D65 item 5 (coverage from the company's own certificate); FS-00 §6.3 dated note of 2026-10-28

vectors.description: BOUNDARY: 16385 bytes. Refused as too large before it is read in full, whether or not it declares its length.
vectors.fsRef: ops decision D65 item 5 (coverage from the company's own certificate); FS-00 §6.3 dated note of 2026-10-28

vectors.description: No body at all carries no certificate.
vectors.fsRef: ops decision D65 item 5 (coverage from the company's own certificate); FS-00 §6.3 dated note of 2026-10-28

vectors.description: A compact JWS has three segments; this has two.
vectors.fsRef: ops decision D65 item 5 (coverage from the company's own certificate); FS-00 §6.3 dated note of 2026-10-28

vectors.description: The header names the algorithm none: refused before any key is looked up, because the certificate profile is ES256 (FS08-050).
vectors.fsRef: ops decision D65 item 5 (coverage from the company's own certificate); FS-00 §6.3 dated note of 2026-10-28; FS08-050

vectors.description: A validly signed supporter certificate is not a waiver certificate: this route reads license-status certificates of the variant waiver only.
vectors.fsRef: ops decision D65 item 5 (coverage from the company's own certificate); FS-00 §6.3 dated note of 2026-10-28; FS08-010

vectors.description: The flattened JSON form with an unprotected header member: everything the route judges must be signed, so the member is refused rather than ignored.
vectors.fsRef: ops decision D65 item 5 (coverage from the company's own certificate); FS-00 §6.3 dated note of 2026-10-28; RFC 7515 §7.2.2

vectors.description: The general JSON serialisation (a signatures array) is not one of the two forms this route reads.
vectors.fsRef: ops decision D65 item 5 (coverage from the company's own certificate); FS-00 §6.3 dated note of 2026-10-28; RFC 7515 §7.2.1

vectors.description: The waiver was recorded within the day: the copy of ct/0.json this edge holds (a numbered segment is held for a day, and the open one grows in place at that path) ends before the issue entry, while ct/latest.json, the open segment at its own five-minute class, carries it. The head is read, the entry carries the SHA-256 of this certificate, and the answer is yes-via-waiver.
vectors.fsRef: ops decision D65 item 5 (coverage from the company's own certificate); FS-00 §6.3 dated note of 2026-10-28; ct-segment.v1 (the open segment at ct/latest.json)

vectors.description: Neither ct/0.json nor ct/latest.json as read reaches the issue entry at record.issueSeq yet. Nothing is asserted about the bytes presented: artifacts_unavailable, to be asked again, and never cert_not_in_ct_log, which says the certificate is not the one issued.
vectors.fsRef: ops decision D65 item 5 (coverage from the company's own certificate); FS-00 §6.3 dated note of 2026-10-28; CERT-030

vectors.description: The key is published compromised after the certificate was signed (as WC-17), and the entry carries no record (as WC-24), only the company id, which is public. Under such a key only the log shows the bytes were issued, and this entry names no log entry: the answer is no, and the certificate cannot be tied.
vectors.fsRef: ops decision D65 item 5 (coverage from the company's own certificate); FS-00 §6.3 dated note of 2026-10-28; FS08-104; CERT-030; waiver.v1 record (absent before recording)
